essence: The Śiva pot and the growth vessel should be placed at the head region of the lord of gods.
After placing eight pots around, one should worship the lords of knowledge there.
After performing the placement of principles, forms, and so on, one should perform the fire offering.
Palāśa, udumbara, aśvattha, and vaṭa trees are assigned to the directions beginning with the east.
The principal palāśa should be placed on the left in all cases.
